title: Stork and Pyth prices can be arbitrated
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  `fullfillOracleQueryStork` and `fullfillOracleQueryPyth` functions are used to update the price of the Stork and the Pyth oracles, respectively.  Given that both oracles work with a pull model, this opens the opportunity to arbitrage a price update by performing a trade, setting the new price, and closing the position, all in the same transaction.
